title: JR East Pokémon Stamp Rally 2026 (Stage 1: Yamanote Metropolitan)
titleJa: JR東日本 ポケモンスタンプラリー2026（ステージ1）
description: Collect 6 legendary and partner Pokémon stamps across Tokyo's busiest Yamanote and metropolitan terminal stations to complete Stage 1 and earn the exclusive commemorative clear file.
reward: Stage 1 Commemorative Clear File & Certificate (Tokyo Station Travel Service Center)
rewardJa: ステージ1 達成記念オリジナルクリアファイル＆認定証

title: Tokyo Metro × Detective Conan Mystery Rally
titleJa: 東京メトロ×名探偵コナン ミステリースタンプラリー
description: Crack subway case clues and gather special detective casebook stamps hidden at 5 key Tokyo underground hub stations.
reward: Limited Edition Conan Detective Pin & Smartphone Wallpaper
rewardJa: 特製ピンバッジ＆オリジナル壁紙

title: Tokyo Metropolitan 9 Heritage Gardens Stamp Trail
titleJa: 都立9庭園 秋のめぐりスタンプラリー
organizer: Tokyo Metropolitan Park Association (東京都公園協会)
description: Stroll through the Edo-period Daimyo gardens and Meiji estates of Tokyo during the autumn foliage season to collect traditional seal stamps.
reward: Traditional Japanese Washi Paper Bookmark & Tea House Voucher
rewardJa: 特製和紙しおり＆茶屋割引券

title: Creative Stationery & Concept Shop Stamp Tour
titleJa: 文具とクリエイティブショップめぐり
description: A curated pilgrimage for journal lovers, travelers, and stationery collectors across Tokyo's most celebrated notebook ateliers and design shops.
reward: Exclusive Embossed Leather Stamp Passport Sticker & Postcard Set
rewardJa: オリジナル箔押しステッカー＆ポストカードセット

title: Kansai Historic Gardens & Ancient Temples Autumn Tour
titleJa: 関西の古刹と名勝庭園 秋の特別スタンプラリー
description: Special limited-time stamp rally celebrating peak autumn foliage across legendary cultural monuments in Kyoto, Osaka, and Okayama.
reward: Autumn Momiji Silk Lucky Charm (Omamori) & Commemorative Tenugui
rewardJa: 紅葉刺繍お守り＆特製手ぬぐい

title: Tōkaidō Shinkansen 60th Anniversary Memorial Rally
titleJa: 東海道新幹線 開業60周年記念スタンプラリー
description: Celebrating 60 years of high-speed rail history from Tokyo to Osaka along the historic Tokaido trunk line.
rewardJa: 0系新幹線 記念メタルキーホルダー
